description: Connects to a SharePoint list used as the help desk ticketing system

operations.description: Creates a new help desk ticket item in the SharePoint list

item.Title: string (required)
item.Category: string (required) - Hardware | Software | Network | Account/Access | Other

operations.description: Retrieves a specific ticket from the SharePoint list
Queries the SharePoint list to find a ticket by its ticket number (e.g., HD-1042)
Updates an existing ticket in the SharePoint list
Retrieves all open tickets submitted by a specific user

setupInstructions.step3: Add the following columns to the list: TicketNumber (Single line of text), Description (Multiple lines of text), Category (Choice), Priority (Choice), Status (Choice), SubmittedBy (Single line of text), SubmittedByEmail (Single line of text), AssignedTeam (Single line of text), SLADeadline (Date and Time), AffectedUsers (Number), Resolution (Multiple lines of text), ResolvedDate (Date and Time)
setupInstructions.step4: In Copilot Studio, go to Settings > Connections
setupInstructions.step5: Add a new SharePoint connection and sign in with your Microsoft 365 account
setupInstructions.step6: Update the siteUrl in settings.json with your SharePoint site URL
